fitted_on.code: vitaldb-resolution 0.6.0 (tag v0.6.0): tools/fit_timestamps.py, tools/fit_volume.py, tools/fit_logt.py, tools/reevaluate_fit.py
fitted_on.seed_note: deterministic optimisers (no random draws in fitting)

supersedes.reason: anaesthesia duration as a latent location covariate; department on the heaping propensities; zero rule (point mass, zero_anuric / zero_unexplained)

resolution.justification: Only 15 of 3,707 values (0.4%) are not multiples of 5; treated as typos or over-precise readings and flagged off_grid.

special_values.handling: zero_model: point mass at 0, flagged zero_anuric or zero_unexplained

latent.note: log f(x | duration) = B(log x - b log(duration / 180))·[0, coefficients] - log x, normalised on the grid; duration = charted anaesthesia duration (aneend - anestart, min); without it, the marginal is used

location_covariates.name: duration
location_covariates.note: charted anaesthesia duration, aneend - anestart, minutes

marginal.note: used when duration is missing: average of the latent over 40 quantiles of log(duration / ref) among the fitted cases

fit.data: VitalDB clinical_data.csv (intraop_uo), positive values on the 5 mL grid with a usable anaesthesia duration
fit.method: tools/fit_volume.py --duration --department: library likelihood, JAX gradient, L-BFGS-B (stopped when 25 iterations gained < 0.001)

previous.note: duration covariate only (0.6.0 development fit); v1 is in archive/

fit.note: n_params counts the capture window, chosen by profile likelihood

zero_model.note: A recorded 0 is a point mass at 0 with probability p0 (zeros / recorded values), mixed with the latent mass that records as 0. The latent and rounding model are fitted on positive values only. Missing values are not zeros: they mean not measured.

zero_anuric.meaning: true zero: preoperative creatinine > 2 mg/dL (renal failure, dialysis) or ASA 6 (organ donor)

zero_unexplained.meaning: recorded 0 with normal creatinine: possibly a blocked catheter or 0 meaning not measured; kept but uncertain

covariate_marginals_note: used when department is missing or not one of the fitted levels: propensities averaged over the department shares of the fitted cases (flag department_marginal)

references.citation: Lee HC, Park Y, Yoon SB, Yang SM, Park D, Jung CW. VitalDB, a high-fidelity multi-parameter vital signs database in surgical patients. Sci Data. 2022;9:279.
Rietveld P. Rounding of arrival and departure times in travel surveys: an interpretation in terms of scheduled activities. J Transp Stat. 2002;5(1):71-81.
references.used_for: rounding probabilities fitted by maximum likelihood; Bayes rule for the true value given the reported one
